name: Pinecone
tagline: Managed vector database and inference APIs for search.
shortDescription: Pinecone offers managed vector search, indexes, namespaces, backups, integrated embedding, and SDKs.
agentSummary: Agents can create indexes, upsert vectors or text, query semantic search, and inspect usage through documented APIs.
bestFor: Hosted vector search, RAG indexes, embeddings, and semantic retrieval.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Agents should manage namespace isolation, deletion safety, and embedding model compatibility. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public pricing for serverless, pod-based, storage, and inference usage.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup with free starter concepts.
browserSupport: Console supports index management and usage review.

capabilities.detail: API reference covers indexes, vectors, search, backups, and inference.
Docs are organized around RAG, search, and index operations.
Pricing is public with usage and plan dimensions.
Self-serve signup with free starter concepts.
Console supports index management and usage review.
